  2022­23, 2023­24 and 2024­25 California Violence, Intervention and
  Prevention (2022­23 to 2024­25 CalVIP) grant award; and related matters.

  Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF
  THE MAYOR:

  1. APPROVE the recommendations contained in the City Administrative
  Officer (CAO) report dated March 2, 2023, attached to Council file No.
  22­1148, relative to the 2022­23 to 2024­25 CalVIP grant award.

  2. ADOPT the accompanying Governing Body RESOLUTION attached
  to the CAO report dated March 2, 2023, attached to Council file No.
  22­1148, as requested by the grantor and subject to the City Attorney
  as to form, which endorses the grant agreement and attests to
  compliance with the program and funding requirements of the grant.

  Fiscal Impact Statement: The CAO reports that the acceptance of the 2022­
  23 CalVIP Cohort IV Grant in the amount of $4,000,000 and approval of
  grant­related actions will result in the implementation of enhanced gang
  prevention and intervention services in the Newton 1, Hollenbeck 1, Mission,
  Harbor, Southeast 1, and Southwest 2 Gang Reduction and Youth
  Development Zones. The required match of $4,000,000 will be satisfied

  Fiscal Impact Statement: The CAO reports that the acceptance of the 2022­
  23 CalVIP Cohort IV Grant in the amount of $4,000,000 and approval of
  grant­related actions will result in the implementation of enhanced gang
  prevention and intervention services in the Newton 1, Hollenbeck 1, Mission,
  Harbor, Southeast 1, and Southwest 2 Gang Reduction and Youth
  Development Zones. The required match of $4,000,000 will be satisfied
  through a combination of salary, fringe benefit costs, and contractual
  services in the current year, and in 2023­24 and 2024­25. The composition
  of the match for 2023­24 and 2024­25 is subject to funding determinations
  by the Mayor and Council through the annual budget process. The proposed
  Reserve Fund loan of $700,000 will used to provide cash­flow for service
  providers, which will be repaid upon final reimbursement of the CalVIP grant
  funds. Although all program costs are fully reimbursable by the grant, any
  significant delays in the timely submission of reimbursement requests will
  impact the repayment of the Reserve Fund loan and result in a negative
  impact to the General Fund. Full repayment will not occur until the end of the
  grant performance period on December 31, 2025.

  Financial Policies Statement: The CAO reports the City’s Financial Policies
  require that the City pursue Federal, State and private grants, but strictly
  limit financial support of these programs to avoid commitments that continue
  beyond available funding. The recommendations in this report comply with
  City Financial Policies in that the proposed funding is balanced against
  established revenue approved by Council actions and from Federal and
  State grant receipts. All funding is subject to the availability of grant funds
  and determinations by Mayor and Council.

  Community Impact Statement: None submitted
